recovery.fileHow: If you forget your password: open the website, choose "Forgot your password?" and enter your username, this code and a new password.
recovery.fileOnce: The code works once. Making a new one cancels this one. Anyone with it can take over your account, so keep this file private.
recovery.onlyHere: It is shown only on this screen. Anyone with it can take over your account; no admin will ever ask for it.
recoveryReminder.openSettings: Open Settings > Account to make your recovery code.
recoveryReminder.text:
Your account has no recovery code yet.

If you ever forget your password, a recovery code is the only way back into your account (decks, progress and friends). It takes a moment: Settings > Account, enter your password and press Create recovery code. The code is saved to a file for you.

replays.refusedUnreadable: This replay cannot be played: its saved rules could not be read, so it would not play out as the real match did.
